Return $\widehat z\in K$, equivalently $(\widehat x,\widehat y)\in X\times Y$. Arbitrary measurable transcript postprocessing is allowed, including unqueried points, averages, or convex combinations, subject to the stated output domain and feasibility. No extra value or computable certificate is required.
The set $K\subset\mathbb R^d$ is known, nonempty, compact, and convex, with $\operatorname{diam}(K)\le D_K$. The operator $F=n^{-1}\sum_iF_i$ is monotone; components need not be monotone.

norms.definition: The Euclidean norm and inner product are $\|v\|_2=(\sum_jv_j^2)^{1/2}$ and $\langle u,v\rangle=\sum_j u_jv_j$. On the joint space use $\|(x,y)\|_2=(\|x\|_2^2+\|y\|_2^2)^{1/2}$.
